text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While resting in my room, my smartphone 
rang.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—What a surprise!
It's a video call from <support>!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seemed she, too,
was looking forward to 
<chrname>'s success.
It served to steel their 
resolve even further.
